Follow these steps to redeem your code and grab your reward: If you don’t have the game, install it through Google play store for Android devices and App Store for Apple devices. After installing, launch the Clash Royale game. Open the menu section by clicking on the three-side bar on the right top corner of your screen. Click on the Supercell ID button and then Log in to your Supercell account in which you want the rewards to be redeemed. Open the supercell store page and scroll down further to find the section where it says “Redeem a Store Code”. Fill in the code and make sure that it is not one of the expired ones for a successful reward redeem. After filling the code, click on the Submit button. Congratulations, you have successfully redeemed your Clash Royale code and it will be sent to your Clash Royale account when you open the app next time. Then, use your device’s scanner or google lens to scan the code. Once scanned, you will get the link for your reward. Click on it and hit the Claim rewards button. It will redirect you to your Clash Royale application where you will receive your rewards. Creator Codes Creator codes are specialized codes generated by Supercell for the Content Creators of Clash Royale on different platforms such as Youtube, Twitch or Steam. They don’t give you free rewards like the gift codes, instead you might get some discount during your Clash Royale top up and a small part of the spent money goes toward the creator. Use these creator codes to apply for discounts during your in-game purchases. After installing, launch the Clash Royale game. Copy the code from our website. Go to your in-game shop and scroll to the very bottom of the menu. Find the Creator Boost section. If you are currently not supporting any Supercell Creator, you will see a “Enter the code” button. Paste your code and hit the “OK” button to apply the code. How to find new Clash Royale codes The Clash Royale Code drops are very frequent as devs love to pamper the players. So, you will have to follow the game’s official social media handles to get up to date for the redeem codes. You can also follow our website for any updates as we are the first to cover any newly dropped Clash Royale codes. Why your code is not working There are several reasons why your Clash Royale gift codes might not be working as it should and these are the most commonly faced reasons: Using expired codes: This is one of the most commonly faced issues where the players try to redeem an already expired code. These codes are time limited codes and will expire after some time. If you try to redeem an expired code, you will not receive the reward. Already Redeemed rewards: If you have already redeemed your reward once, you might not be able to redeem more of it because most of the codes provide only one time redemption for a single supercell ID. Limited Redemption: Some of the Clash royale codes come with a limit on their redemption. For example, let’s say there is a limit of 10 redemption and you are the 11th one to redeem, then you won’t receive any rewards. Typographical error: Another common mistake is actually a mistake. The codes are case sensitive and even if you get a single letter wrong, you won’t be able to redeem the reward. Server Issue: Sometimes, the server might be down or your internet connection can be very weak causing the redemption process to fail. Try again when the issue is fixed. Conclusion In conclusion, the rewards you get from redeeming the Clash royale codes is valuable and you must not miss on any of these codes and QR. If you have used up all your codes to redeem the free rewards, wait patiently for the new ones and follow social platforms and sites like ours to get daily updates.
